G2600.def:
κατα-βαρύνω 
[in LXX: 2 Rois 13:25 14:26 (כָּבַד), Joël 2:8, Sir.8:15 * ;] 
= καταβαρέω: pass., Pres. ptcp., Marc 14:40.†

G2602.def:
κατα-βολή, -ῆς, ἡ
(καταβάλλω), [in LXX: 2Ma.2:29 * ;] 
__1. a laying down: εἰς κ. σπέρματος, Hébreux 11:11 (EV, to conceive seed). 
__2. a foundation (of a house, ii Mac, l.with): metaphorically, ἀπὸ κ. κόσμου, Matthieu 13:35 (LXX) (om. ἀπὸ κ. κόσμου, WH, R, mg.), Matthieu 25:34, Luc 11:50, Hébreux 4:3 9:26, Apocalypse 13:8 17:8; πρὸ κ. κόσμου, Jean 17:24, Éphésiens 1:4, 1 Pierre 1:20.†

G2603.def:
κατα-βραβεύω
(βραβεύς, an umpire, cf βραβεῖον) 
to give judg­ment against, condemn (see Field, Notes, 196; Abbott, Essays, 104 f.): Colossiens 2:18.†

G2604.def:
καταγγελεύς, -έως, ὁ 
a proclaimer, herald (in Inscr., κ. ἀγώνων, Deiss., LAE, 97): with genitive obj., Actes 17:18.†

G2605.def:
κατ-αγγέλλω 
[in LXX: Proverbes 17:5 A, 2Ma.8:36 2Mac 9:17 * ;] 
__1. to pro­claim, declare: with accusative of thing(s), Actes 3:24 16:21 17:23; τ. ἀνάστασιν, Actes 4:2; τ. λόγον τοῦ Θ., τ. Κ., Actes 13:5 15:36; ὁδὸν σωτηρίας, Actes 16:17; φῶς, Actes 26:23; τ. μυστήριον τοῦ Θ., 1 Corinthiens 2:1; τ. εὐαγγέλιον, 1 Corinthiens 9:14; τ. θάνατον τοῦ Κ., 1 Corinthiens 11:26; pass., ἄφεσις, Actes 13:33; ὁ λόγος τοῦ Θ., Actes 17:13; ἡ πίστις ὑμῶν, Romains 1:8; with accusative of person(s), of Christ, ὅν, Actes 17:3, Colossiens 1:28; τ. Χριστόν, Philippiens 1:17; pass., Philippiens 1:18. 
__2. to denounce (Xen., al.); (for comparison with ἀγγέλλω, ἀναγ-, ἀπαγ-, see Westc. on 1 Jean 1:5; and cf. προ-καταγγέλλω).†

G2606.def:
κατα-γελάω, -ῶ 
[in LXX chiefly for שָׂחַק, Job 5:22, Proverbes 29:9, al. ;] 
to deride, laugh scornfully at: with genitive of person(s), Matthieu 9:24, Marc 5:40, Luc 8:53.†

G2607.def:
κατα-γινώσκω
(see: γινώσκω), [in LXX: Deutéronome 25:1 (רָשַׁע hi.), Proverbes 28:11 (חָקַר), Sir.14:2 19:5 * ;] 
to blame, condemn: with genitive of person(s), 1 Jean 3:20-21; pass., κατεγνωσμένος ἦν (RV, he stood condemned, see Ellie., in l; but cf. Field, Notes, 188): Galates 2:11.†

G2608.def:
κατ-άγνυμι 
[in LXX for נָחַת pi., etc. ;] 
to break: with accusative of thing(s), Matthieu 12:20 (LXX), Jean 19:31-33.†

G2609.def:
κατ-άγω 
[in LXX chiefly for יָרַד hi. ;] 
to bring down: with accusative of person(s), Actes 22:30, Romains 10:6; id. before εἰς, Actes 9:30 23:15, 20 23:28; as nautical term, to bring to land: τ. πλοῖον ἐπὶ τ. γῆν, Luc 5:11; pass., before εἰς, Actes 27:3 2:12.†

G2611.def:
κατα-δέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX for חָבַשׁ, etc. ;] 
to bind up: τ. τραύματα (cf. Sir.27:21), Luc 10:34.†

G2613.def:
κατα-δικάζω 
[in LXX: Psaumes 94:21 (רָשַׁע hi.), La 3:36 (עָוַת pi.), Wis.2:20, al. ;] 
to pass sentence upon, condemn; in cl., with genitive of person(s) (accusative of thing(s)); in late writers (so LXX), with accusative of person(s) (θανάτῳ, Wis, l.with): Matthieu 12:7, Jacques 5:6; absol. (as Plat., Legg., 958c), Luc 6:37; pass., Matthieu 12:37, Luc 6:37.†
δικάζω, 
to judge: Luc 6:37 (Tr., mg.; see: καταδ-; Cremer, 199).†

G2614.def:
κατα-διώκω 
[in LXX chiefly for רָדַף ;] 
"perfective" compound (M, Pr., 116), to pursue closely, follow up 
__(a) with hostile intent (Thuc., i, 49, Genèse 31:36 al.); 
__(b) with kindly intention (Psaumes 23:6, 1 Rois 30:22, cf. Sir.27:17): Marc 1:36.†

G2615.def:
κατα-δουλόω, -ῶ 
[in LXX chiefly for עָבַד ;] 
to enslave: 2 Corinthiens 11:20, Galates 2:4.†

G2616.def:
κατα-δυναστεύω 
[in LXX for יָנָה, עָשַׁק, etc. ;] 
to exercise power over, oppress: with accusative of person(s) (Xen.; LXX, Michée 2:2, Wis.2:10, al.); with genitive of person(s), Jacques 2:6 (ὑμᾶς, T); pass., Actes 10:38 (cf. MM, Exp., xv).†

G2617.def:
κατ-αισχύνω 
[in LXX chiefly for בּוּשׁ ;] 
to disgrace, dishonour, put to shame: with accusative of thing(s), 1 Corinthiens 11:4-5; with accusative of person(s), 1 Corinthiens 1:27 11:22; pass., to be ashamed: Luc 13:17, 2 Corinthiens 7:14 9:4, 1 Pierre 3:16; as in LXX (Psaumes 22:6 25:2-3, al.), of unfulfilled hopes: Romains 5:5; pass., Romains 9:33 10:11, 1 Pierre 2:6" (LXX) .†

G2618.def:
κατα-καίω 
[in LXX chiefly for שָׂרַף; in Exode 3:2 (אָכַל pu.), distinguished from καίω ;] 
to burn up, burn completely: with accusative of thing(s), Matthieu 13:30 Actes 19:19; pass., 1 Corinthiens 3:15, Hébreux 13:11, 2 Pierre 3:10, Apocalypse 8:7; before πυρί Matthieu 3:12 13:40, Luc 3:17 (cf. Exode 29:14, al.); ἐν πυρί (Deutéronome 9:21, al.): Apocalypse 17:16 18:8.†

G2619.def:
κατα-καλύπτω 
[in LXX chiefly for כָּסָה pi. ;] 
to cover up; mid., to cover or veil oneself: 1 Corinthiens 11:6; τ. κεφαλήν, 1 Corinthiens 11:7.†

G2620.def:
κατα-καυχάομαι, -ῶμαι 
[in LXX: Zacharie 10:12 (הָלַךְ hith.), Jérémie 50:11 (עָלַז), Jérémie 50:38 (הָלַל)* ;] 
__1. to boast against, exult over: with genitive, Romains 11:18, Jacques 2:13; before κατά, with genitive, Jacques 3:14 (T, om. κατά). 
__2. before ἐν, to glory in (Za., l.with, Jérémie 27:38).†

G2621.def:
κατά-κειμαι 
[in LXX: Proverbes 6:9 23:34 (שָׁכַב), Jdth.13:15, Wis.17:7 * ;] 
__1. to lie down. 
__2. to lie sick: Marc 1:30 2:4, Jean 5:6, Actes 28:8; before ἐπί with genitive, Actes 9:33; id. with accusative, Luc 5:25; ἐν, Jean 5:3. 
__3. to recline at meals (cf. ἀνάιειμαι): Marc 14:3, Luc 5:29; before ἐν, Marc 2:15, Luc 7:37, 1 Corinthiens 8:10.†

G2622.def:
κατα-κλάω, -ῶ 
[in LXX: Eze.19:12 (נָתַשׁ hoph.)* ;] 
to break up, break in pieces: Marc 6:41, Luc 9:16.†

G2623.def:
κατα-κλείω 
[in LXX: Jérémie 32:3 (כָּלָא), Wis.17:2, 16, 2Ma.13:21, 3Ma.3:25 * ;] 
to shut up:. with accusative of person(s), before ἐν φυλακῇ (-αῖς), Luc 3:20, Actes 26:10.†

G2624.def:
κατα-κληρονομέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX for נָחַל, יָרַשׁ, etc. ;] 
__1. to distribute by lot or as an inheritance (Nombres 34:18, Josué 14:1, al.): Actes 13:19. 
__2. to receive by inheritance (Deutéronome 1:38, al.).†
κατα-κληροδοτέω, ῶ, 
[in LXX: Deutéronome 1:38 21:16 A (-νομέω, B), (נָחַל), 1Ma.3:36 א R (-νομέω, A)* ;] 
Actes 13:19, Rec., = -νομέω, which see†

G2625.def:
κατα-κλίνω 
[in LXX: Exode 21:18 (נָפַל), Nombres 24:9, Juges 5:27, 1 Rois 16:11 (כָּרַע), Jdth.12:15, 3Ma.1:3 * ;] 
to lay down, make to lie down, esp. for meals: with accusative of person(s), Luc 9:14-15; mid., to recline at meals: Luc 7:36 24:30; before εἰς, Luc 14:8 (cf. Jth, Lc.).†

G2626.def:
κατα-κλύζω 
[in LXX for שָׁטַף, Psaumes 78:20, al. ;] 
to inundate, deluge: pass., 2 Pierre 3:6.†

G2627.def:
κατα-κλυσμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(κατακλύζω), [in LXX chiefly for מַבּוּל, Genèse 6:17, al.; also for שֶׁטֶף, Psaumes 32:6, al. ;] 
a flood, deluge: Matthieu 24:38-39 Luc 17:27, 2 Pierre 2:5.†

G2628.def:
κατ-ακολουθέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX: Jérémie 17:16 (רָאָה), 1Ma.6:23, al. ;] 
to follow after: Luc 23:55; with dative of person(s), Actes 16:17.†

G2629.def:
κατα-κόπτω 
[in LXX for נָכָה hi., כָּתַת pi., etc. ;] 
to cut up, cut in pieces (cf. Ésaïe 27:9, Jérémie 21:7, 2 Chroniques 34:7): ἑαυτὸν λίθοις, Marc 5:5.†

G2630.def:
κατα-κρημνίζω
(κρημνός), [in LXX: 2 Chroniques 25:12 (שָׁלַךְ hi.), 2Ma.12:15 2Mac 14:43, 4Ma.4:25*.] 
to throw over a precipice, cast down head­long: Luc 4:29.†

G2631.def:
κατά-κριμα, -τος, τό
(κατακρίνω), 
penalty (RV, condemnation; but cf. Deiss., BS, 264 f.; MM, Exp., xv): Romains 5:16, 18 8:1.†

G2632.def:
κατα-κρίνω 
[in LXX: Esther 2:1 (גָּזַר ni.), Wis.4:16, Dan LXX TH Sus 1:53, 4:34, TH Sus 1:41,48,53* ;] 
to give judgment against, condemn: Romains 8:34; with accusative of person(s), Marc 14:64, Jean 8:10-11; disting. fr. κρίνειν, Romains 2:1, 1 Corinthiens 11:32; before θανάτῳ (cl. -ου or -ον), Matthieu 20:18, Marc 10:33; pass., Matthieu 27:3, Marc 16:16, Romains 14:23, 1 Corinthiens 11:32, 2 Pierre 2:6. Metaphorical, of condemning through a good example: Matthieu 12:41-42, Luc 11:31-32, Romains 8:3, Hébreux 11:7 †

G2633.def:
κατά-κρισις, -εως, ἡ
(κατακρίνω), 
condemnation: 2 Corinthiens 3:9 7:3 (cf. Deiss., LAE, 91 f.).†

G2635.def:
κατα-λαλέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX chiefly for דָבַר ni., pi. ;] 
to speak evil of, rail at: in cl., with accusative; in LXX, 
__(a) with genitive, 
__(b) before κατά, with genitive; in NT, with genitive (M, Pr., 65): Jacques 4:11, 1 Pierre 2:12; pass., 1 Pierre 3:16,†

G2636.def:
κατα-λαλιά, -ᾶς, ἡ
(κατάλαλος), [in LXX: Wis.1:11 * ;] 
evil-speaking, railing: p1., 2 Corinthiens 12:20, 1 Pierre 2:1.†

G2637.def:
κατά-λαλος, -ου, ὁ 
a railer, defamer: Romains 1:30.†
SYN.: (ψιθυριστής), a whisperer (see Tr., Syn., § cvii, 15; Lft., Notes, 256)

G2638.def:
κατα-λαμβάνω 
[in LXX for נָשַׂג hi., לָכַד, etc. ;] 
__1. to lap hold of, seize, appropriate: Marc 9:18; with accusative of thing(s), 1 Corinthiens 9:24, Philippiens 3:12-13 
__2. to overtake: as carrel, of διώκω (Field, Notes, 158 f.), Romains 9:30; ἡ ἡμέρα, 1 Thessaloniciens 5:4; of evils, Jean 1:5 12:35 (cf. 617 T); hence, to surprise, discover: Jean 8:3-4], 
__3. Of mental action, to apprehend, comprehend; so mid., in NT (M, Pr., 158): Éphésiens 3:18; before ὅτι, Actes 4:13 10:34; with accusative and inf., Actes 25:25 (MM, Exp., xv).†

G2639.def:
κατα-λέγω 
[in LXX: Deutéronome 19:16 (עָנָה), 2Ma.7:30 R * ;] 
__1. to lay down; mid. (in Hom.), to lie down. 
__2. to narrate (LXX, ll. with). 
__3. to choose out, hence, to enrol (as of soldiers, Hdt., Thuc., a1., see LS, see word): of widows, pass., 1 Timothée 5:9 (cf. Ellic.; CGT, in l).†

G2641.def:
κατα-λείπω 
[in LXX chiefly far שָׁאַר, ni., hi., also for עָזַב, יָתַר, etc. ;] 
__1 1, to leave behind, leave: with accusative of person(s) (of thing(s)), Matthieu 4:13, Marc 12:19, 21, Luc 20:31, Actes 24:27 25:14, Hébreux 11:27; of sailing by a place, Actes 21:3; ptcp., καταλιπών, redundant (Dalman, Words, 21 f.), Matthieu 16:4 21:17; pass., Jean 8:9, 1 Thessaloniciens 3:1; metaphorically, εὐθεῖαν ὁδόν, 2 Pierre 2:15. 
__2. to forsake, abandon: Matthieu 19:5, Marc 10:7" (LXX) Marc 14:52, Luc 5:28 15:4, Actes 6:2, Éphésiens 5:31" (LXX) . 
__3. to leave remaining, reserve: with accusative and inf., Luc 10:40; ἐμαυτῷ, Romains 11:4 (LXX); pass., Hébreux 4:1 (cf. ἐν-κατα-λείπω).†

G2642.def:
κατα-λιθάζω
(= cl. -θόω; cf. -θοβολέω, Exode 17:4, Num_14:10) 
to cast stones at, to stone: Luc 20:6.†

G2643.def:
κατ-αλλαγή, -ῆς, ἡ 
(καταλλάσσω), [in LXX: Ésaïe 9:5(4), 2Ma.5:20 * ;] 
__1. exchange. 
__2. reconciliation: Romains 5:11; κ. κόσμου, Romains 11:15; διακονία τῆς κ., 2 Corinthiens 5:18; λόγος τῆς κ., 2 Corinthiens 5:19.†

G2644.def:
κατ-αλλάσσω
(Att.. -ττω; cf. ἀλλάσσω) [in LXX: Jérémie 48:39 (חָתַת), 2Ma.1:5 2Mac 7:33 2Mac 8:29 * ;] 
prop., to change, exchange (esp. of money); hence, of persons, to change from emnity to friendship, to reconcile (for exx. in cl., see Thayer„ LS): of the reconciliation of man to God (Lft., Notes, 288; ICC on Ro, l.with; DCG, ii, 474, 797), 2 Corinthiens 5:18-19; pass Romains 5:10, 2 Corinthiens 5:20; of a woman returning to her husband, 1 Corinthiens 7:11 (cf. ἀπο-καταλλάσσω).†

G2645.def:
κατά-λοιπος, -ον 
[in LXX for שָׁאַר, שְׁאֵרִית, יָתַר, etc. ;] 
left remaining: ἱο κ. τ. ἀνθρώπων, Actes 15:17 (LXX).†

G2646.def:
κατά-λυμα, -τος, τό
(καταλύω), [in LXX: Exode 4:24 (מָלוֹן), 1 Rois 9:22 (לִשְׁכָּה), etc. ;] 
__1. = cl. καταγώγιον (cf. πανδοχεῖον), an inn, lodgingplace: Luc 2:7 (so Ex, l.with, and MGr.). 
__2. a guest-room (1Sam,l.with): Marc 14:14, Luc 22:11.†

G2647.def:
κατα-λύω 
[in LXX for לוּן, שָׁבַת, etc. ;] 
__1. to destroy, cast down: Matthieu 24:2, Marc 13:2, Luc 21:6; τ. ναόν, Matthieu 26:61 27:40, Marc 14:58 15:29, Actes 6:14; οἰκίαν, 2 Corinthiens 5:1; opposite to οἰκοδομεῖν, Galates 2:18. Metaphorical, to overthrow, annul, abrogate: Actes 5:38-39; τ. ἔργον τ. θεοῦ, Romains 14:20; τ. νόμον, Matthieu 5:17 (2Ma.2:22). 
__2. to unloose, unyoke (e.g. horses), hence intrans., of travellers (cf. κατάλυμα), to take up one's quarters, lodge (cl., Genèse 19:2, al.): Luc 9:12 19:7.†

G2648.def:
κατα-μανθάνω 
[in LXX: Genèse 34:1 (רָאָה), Job 35:4 (5) (שׁוּר), Sir.9:5, 8, al. ;] 
to learn thoroughly, observe well, consider carefully (on distinction bet. κ. and μανθάνω, cf. M, Pr., 117): Matthieu 6:28.†

G2649.def:
κατα-μαρτυρέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX: Job 15:6, Proverbes 25:18 (עָנָה), al. ;] 
to bear witness againt: with accusative of thing(s) and genitive of person(s), Matthieu 26:62 27:13, Marc 14:60.†

G2650.def:
κατα-μένω 
[in LXX for יָשַׁב (Nombres 20:1, al.), etc. ;] 
to remain permanently, abide: Actes 1:13, 1 Corinthiens 16:6, WH (παραμ-, T, EV).†

G2653.def:
κατα-θεματίζω 
to curse vehemently: Matthieu 26:74 (cf. ἀναθεμ-).†

G2654.def:
κατ-αν-αλίσκω 
[in LXX chiefly forאָכַל ;] 
__1. to use up, spend. 
__2. to consume: of fire, ptcp., Hébreux 12:29 (LXX).†

G2655.def:
κατα-ναρκάω, -ῶ
(ναρκάω, to grow numb, in LXX, in causal sense, for יָקַע, Genèse 32:25 (26); without Heb. equiv., Genèse 32:32 (33) Job 33:19, Dan LXX 11:6*); 
__1. to cause to grow numb. 
__2. Intrans., to grow numb; hence metaphorically, to be inactive, be burdensome to with genitive, 2 Corinthiens 11:9 12:13-14; pass., to be quite numb (Hippocr.).†

G2656.def:
κατα-νεύω 
__1. to nod assent, 
__2. to make a sign by nodding the head: with dative of person(s), Luc 5:7.†

G2657.def:
κατα-νοέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX for נָבַט hi., רָאָה, etc. ;] 
to take note of, perceive, consider carefully: Actes 7:31-32; with accusative of thing(s), Matthieu 7:3, Luc 6:41 12:24, 27 20:23, Actes 11:6 27:39, Romains 4:19; with accusative of person(s), Hébreux 3:1 10:24, Jacques 1:23-24 (on the distinction bet. κ. and νοέω simplex, see M, Pr., 117).†

G2658.def:
κατ-αντάω, -ῶ 
[in LXX: 2 Rois 3:29 (חוּל), 2Ma.4:21 2Mac 4:24 2Mac 4:44 2Mac 6:14 * ;] 
to come to, arrive at: before εἰς, with accusative loc., Actes 16:1 18:19, 24 21:7 25:13 (see M, Pr., 132) Actes 27:12 28:13; before ἀντικρύ, with genitive, Actes 20:15. Metaphorical, before εἰς, with accusative of person(s), 1 Corinthiens 10:11 14:36; id. with accusative of thing(s), to attain to: Actes 26:7, Éphésiens 4:13, Philippiens 3:11.†

G2659.def:
κατά-νυξις, -εως, ἡ
(κατανύσσω, which see), [in LXX: Psaumes 60:3 (תַּרְעֵלָה), Ésaïe 29:10 (תַּרְדֵּמָה)* ;] 
__1. a pricking. 
__2. (Perhaps through resembl. of κατανύσσω to -νυστάζω), torpor of mind, stupefaction: Romains 11:8 (LXX) (see ICC, in l; Field, Notes, 157).†

G2660.def:
κατα-νύσσω 
[in LXX: Genèse 34:7 (עָצַב hith.), Lévitique 10:3, Psaumes 4:4, Psa 29:12, al. (דָּמַם), Dan LXX TH Sus 1:10 (רָדַם ni.), Sir.12:12 14:1, al. ;] 
__1. to strike or prick violently. 
__2. to stun. 
__3. Of strong emotion, pass., to be smitten: τὴν καρδίαν, Actes 2:37 (see: κατάνυξις).†

G2661.def:
κατ-αξιόω, -ῶ 
[in LXX: 2Ma.13:12, 3Ma.3:21 3Mac 4:11, 4Ma.18:3 * ;] 
to deem worthy: with accusative of person(s) and genitive of thing(s), 2 Thessaloniciens 1:5; pass. before inf., Luc 20:35, Actes 5:41.†

G2662.def:
κατα-πατέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX for דָּרַךְ, רָמַס, שָׁאַף, etc. ;] 
to tread down, trample under foot: Matthieu 7:6, Luc 12:1; pass., Matthieu 5:13, Luc 8:5. Metaphorical, τ. υἱὸν τ. θεοῦ, Hébreux 10:29.†

G2663.def:
κατά-παυσις, -εως, ἡ
(καταπαύω), [in LXX chiefly for מְנוּחָה, Psaumes 95:11, Ésaïe 66:1, al.; ἡμέρα τῆς κ., 2Ma.15:1] 
__1. in cl., a putting to rest, causing to cease. 
__2. In LXX and NT, rest, repose: Actes 7:49 (LXX), Hébreux 3:11, 18 4:1, 3 4:5, 10-11†

G2664.def:
κατα-παύω 
[in LXX for נוּחַ, שָׁבַת, etc. ;] 
__1. trans., 
__(a) to cause to cease, restrain: Actes 14:18; 
__(b) to cause to rest: Hébreux 4:8. 
__2. Intrans., to rest: before ἀτό, Hébreux 4:4 (LXX), Hébreux 4:10.†

G2665.def:
κατα-πέτασμα, -τος, τό
(= cl. παραπέτασμα) [in LXX chiefly for פֹּרֶכֶת (the veil of the Holy of Holies), Exode 26:31, Lévitique 21:23, al.; also for מָסָךְ (the outer veil), Exode 35:12, Num_3:26, al. (elsewhere κάλυμμα) ;] 
in NT always the inner veil or curtain of the Temple (or Tabernacle): Matthieu 27:51, Marc 15:38, Luc 23:45, Hébreux 6:19 9:3; figuratively, ἡ σὰρξ αὐτοῦ Hébreux 10:20.†

G2666.def:
κατα-πίνω 
[in LXX chiefly for בָּלַע ;] 
__1. to drink down, swallow: Matthieu 23:24, Apocalypse 12:16. 
__2. to devour: 1 Pierre 5:8. Metaphorical, to swallow up, consume: pass., 1 Corinthiens 15:54 (LXX), 2 Corinthiens 2:7 5:4, Hébreux 11:29.†

G2667.def:
κατα-πίπτω 
[in LXX: Psaumes 145:14 (נָפַל), etc. ;] 
to fall down: Actes 28:6; before εἰς, Actes 26:14; ἐπί with accusative, Luc 8:6.†

G2668.def:
κατα-πλέω, -ῶ 
to sail down, sail to land, put in: εἰς τ. χώραν, Luc 8:26.†

G2669.def:
κατα-πονέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX: 2Ma.8:2 (A), 3Ma.2:2 3Mac 2:13 * ;] 
to wear down, oppress, treat hardly: pass., Actes 7:24, 2 Pierre 2:7.†

G2670.def:
κατα-πονίζω 
[in LXX for טָבַע pu., Exode 15:4 A, בָּלַע pi., שָׁטַף, Psaumes 55:9 69:2, al. ;] 
to throw into the sea, sink or drown therein: Matthieu 14:30; pass., Matthieu 18:6.†

G2671.def:
κατ-άρα, -ας, -ἡ 
[in LXX chiefly for קְלָלָה ;] 
a curse: Galates 3:10, 13 Hébreux 6:8, 2 Pierre 2:14; opposite to εὐλογία, Jacques 3:10; concrete, of Christ, Galates 3:13 (see Lft. in l).†

G2672.def:
κατ-αράομαι, -ώμαι depon. 
(κατάρα), [in LXX chiefly for קָלַל pi. ;] 
to curse: with accusative, Marc 11:21; opposite to εὐλογέω, Luc 6:26, Romains 12:14, Jacques 3:9; pass. pf. ptcp., accursed, under a curse (see M, Pr., 221): Matthieu 25:41.†

G2673.def:
κατ-αργέω, -ῶ
(κατά, causative, ἀργός = ἀ-εργός), [in LXX: 2Es.4.21; 2Es.4.23; 2Es.5.5; 2Es.6.8 (בְּטֵל)* ;] 
to make idle or inactive (χέρας, Eur., Phœn., 753): of soil occupied by an unfruitful tree, Luc 13:7. Metaphorical (Inscr.), to render inoperative or invalid, to abrogate, abolish: Romains 3:3, 31, 1 Corinthiens 1:28 6:13 13:11 15:24, Galates 3:17, Éphésiens 2:15, 2 Thessaloniciens 2:8, 2 Timothée 1:10, Hébreux 2:14; pass., Romains 4:14 6:6, 1 Corinthiens 2:6 13:8 13:10 15:26, 2 Corinthiens 3:7 3:11-14 Galates 5:11; before ἀπό (of persons), to be separated, discharged or loosed from, Romains 7:2, 6, Galates 5:4.†

G2674.def:
κατ-αριθμέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX: 2 Chroniques 31:19 (יָחַשׂ hith.), al. ;] 
to number or count among: before ἐν, Actes 1:1.†

G2676.def:
κατ-άρτισις, -εως, ἡ
(καταρτίζω), 
a strengthening, making fit: in ethical sense, 2 Corinthiens 13:9.†

G2677.def:
καταρτισμός, -οῦ, ὁ 
[in Sm.: Ésaïe 38:12 * ;] 
= κατάρτισις (but see ICC, Eph. l.with): Éphésiens 4:12.†

G2678.def:
κατα-σείω 
[in LXX: Da TH Bel 1:14 AR, 1Ma.6:38 * ;] 
__1. to shake down. 
__2. Of the hand, to shake or wave as a signal: τ. χεῖρα, Actes 19:33; τ. χειρί, Actes 13:16; id. with dative of person(s), Actes 21:40; before inf., Actes 12:17.†

G2679.def:
κατα-σκάπτω 
[in LXX for נָתַץ, הָרַס, etc. ;] 
to dig down: Romains 11:3 (LXX).†

G2680.def:
κατα-σκευάζω 
[in LXX: Ésaïe 40:19, 28, (בָּרָא), etc. ;] 
to prepare, make ready: τ. ὁδόν, Matthieu 11:10, Marc 1:2, Luc 7:27; οἶκον, Hébreux 3:3-4; σκηνήν, Hébreux 9:2, 6; κιβωτόν, Hébreux 11:7, 1 Pierre 3:20; pass. pf. ptcp., λαον κ., Luc 1:17.†

G2681.def:
κατα-σκηνόω, -ῶ 
[in LXX chiefly for סָכַךְ ;] 
to pitch one's tent, lodge, dwell: before ἐν, Matthieu 13:32, Luc 13:19; ὑπό, with accusative, Marc 4:32; ἐπ᾽ ἐλπιδι, Actes 2:26 (LXX).†

G2682.def:
κατα-σκήνωσις, εως, ἡ
[in LXX: 1 Chroniques 28:2 (בָּנָה), Eze.37:27 (מִשְׁכָּן) Tob.1:4, Wis.9:8, 2Ma.14:35 (R)* ;] 
__1. prop., an encamping, taking up one's quarters (Polyb., al., see LS; and cf. LXX, ll. with). 
__2. a lodging, abode: of birds, Matthieu 8:20, Luc 9:58.†

G2683.def:
κατα-σκιάζω 
to overshadow: with accusative, Hébreux 9:5.†

G2684.def:
κατα-σκοπέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX: 4Ki.10:3, 1 Chroniques 19:3 (רָגַל pi.), 1Ma.5:38 (A)* ;] 
to view closely, inspect, spy out: with accusative, Galates 2:4.†

G2685.def:
κατά-σκοπος, -ου, ὁ 
[in LXX for רָגַל pi. ;] 
a spy: Hébreux 11:31.†

G2686.def:
κατα-σοφίζομαι 
[in LXX: Exode 1:10 (חָכָם hith.), Jdth.5:11 10:19 * ;] 
to deal craftily with, outwit: Actes 7:19 (LXX) †

G2687.def:
κατα-στέλλω 
[in LXX: 2Ma.4:31, 3Ma.6:1 * ;] 
__1. to let down, lower. 
__2. to keep down, restrain: with accusative, Actes 19:35-36 †

G2688.def:
κατά-στημα, -τος, τό
(καθίστημι), in LXX: 3Ma.5:45 (-εμα, A) * ;] 
__1. condition, of health, etc. 
__2. demeanour: Tite 2:3 (for exx. see Field, Notes, 220).†

G2689.def:
κατα-στολή, -ῆς, ἡ
(καταστέλλω), [in LXX: Ésaïe 61:3 (מַעֲטֶה)* ;] 
__1. a letting down, checking. 
__2. steadiness, quietness in demeanour. 
__3. LXX and NT (cf. Plut., ii, 65 D; -ίζω = vestire), a garment, dress, attire: 1 Timothée 2:9 (but see Ellic., in l).†

G2690.def:
κατα-στρέφω 
[in LXX for הָפַךְ, etc., Genèse 19:21, Jérémie 20:16, al. ;] 
__1. to turn down, turn over; as, the soil. 
__2. to overturn, overthrow: Matthieu 21:12, Marc 11:15; pass. pf. ptcp., Actes 15:16 (LXX).†

G2691.def:
κατα-στρηνιάω, -ῶ 
to wax wanton against: with genitive, 1 Timothée 5:11

G2692.def:
κατα-στροφή, -ῆς, ἡ 
(καταστρέφω), [in LXX: Job 21:17, Proverbes 1:27 (אֵיד), al. ;] 
__1. overthrow: 2 Pierre 2:6 (WH, om.). 
__2. Metaphorical, subversion, upsetting (cf. καθαίρεσις, 2 Corinthiens 13:10): 2 Timothée 2:14.†

G2693.def:
κατα-στρώννυμι 
[in LXX: Nombres 14:16 (שָׁחַט), Job 12:23 (שָׁטַח), שָׁטַח), Jdt.4.1-15; Jdt.2.1-28 Mac.4 ;] 
__1. to strew or spread over. 
__2. to lay low, overthrow: 1 Corinthiens 10:5.†

G2694.def:
κατα-σύρω 
[in LXX: Jérémie 49:10 (חָשַׂף), Dan LXX, Daniel 11:10, 26 (שָׁטַף) * ;] 
__1. to pull down. 
__2. to drag away: with accusative of person(s), Luc 12:58.†

G2695.def:
κατα-σφάζω 
[in LXX: Zacharie 11:5 (הָרַג), Eze.16:40 (בָּתַק pi.), 2Ma.8:1-36 ;] 
to kill off, slay: with accusative, Luc 19:27.†

G2696.def:
κατα-σφραγίζω 
[in LXX: Job 9:7 37:7 (חָתַם), Wis.2:5 * ;] 
to seal up, secure with a seal: Apocalypse 5:1.†

G2697.def:
κατά-σχεσις, -εως, ἡ
(κατέχω), [in LXX nearly always for אֲחֻזָּה ] 
__1. a holding back. 
__2. LXX and NT, a holding fast, possession: Actes 7:5, 45.†

G2698.def:
κατα-τίθημι 
[in LXX: 1 Chroniques 21:27 שׁוּב hi.), Psaumes 41:8 (יָצַק), 1Ma.10:23, al. ;] 
to lay down, deposit, lay by: Marc 15:46, T; mid., to lay up for oneself: χάριν (Hdt., al., see LS, see word), with dative of person(s), Actes 24:27 25:9.†

G2699.def:
κατα-τομή, -ῆς, ἡ 
[in Sm.: Jérémie 31:37 (κατατέμνω is used in LXX of forbidden mutilations: Lévitique 21:5, al.) ;] 
__1. incision. 
__2. excision, concision, mutilation: in sarcasm, by paronomasia, in contrast to (true) περιτομή (v3), of Judaizing Christians, Philippiens 3:2 (see Lft., in l; Cremer, 883).†
